description: This Java source file defines an interface for mapping search domain objects to data transfer objects in the Fineract project. It uses MapStruct for object mapping and includes methods for converting client search data including status enumeration.

classes.name: ClientSearchDataMapper
classes.description: Mapper interface for converting SearchedClient objects to ClientSearchData objects with customized status mapping.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a SearchedClient object to a ClientSearchData object, specifically converting the status field using the 'toStatus' method.

methods.name: toStatus
methods.description: Converts a SearchedClient's status into an EnumOptionData object using ClientEnumerations.status().
